description: `<render of=@count/>` names an integer cell. Per §19.15.3 the subject must be enum-typed, so E-RENDER-NOT-ENUM fires (§34: Error).
rationale: §19.15.3 — `<render>` dispatches on VARIANT: it picks the `renders` clause of whichever variant the subject currently holds. A non-enum subject has no variants, so there is no dispatch to perform — the element is only meaningful over a sum type.
